data.value: The actions on this page change Windows settings. So that you can go back to the previous configuration if anything goes wrong, saving your current settings before you change anything is recommended. You can restore saved settings any time from "My saved settings".

data.name: UiFoxdpiModuluAcikKaynakliGoodbyedpi

data.name: UiTourSectionNote
data.value: You can watch the short tour of FoxFix's main parts again at any time.

data.name: TourPromptTitle
data.value: Would you like a short tour of FoxFix?

data.name: TourPromptText
data.value: We show the main parts in under a minute. You can start the tour again any time from the Settings page.

data.name: TourWelcomeText
data.value: FoxFix finds and fixes problems with your internet connection, DNS and blocked sites. This short tour introduces the main parts.

data.name: TourFixText
data.value: If the check finds a problem, you start the fix here. What will change is listed first; nothing changes without your approval and changes can be undone.

data.name: TourConnectionText
data.value: Checks every step from your computer to the internet (network, modem, DNS, secure connection) in order and explains the result in plain words.

data.name: TourTweaksText
data.value: Manage start-up programs, unneeded files and Windows settings here. The effect of each setting is written next to it; saving your current settings before you change anything is recommended.

data.name: TourDpiText
data.value: FoxDPI lets you reach sites that are blocked. "Find the best setting" finds the one that suits your network, then you start FoxDPI. It runs in its own small window: minimise it and it goes to the notification area, close it and it stops. Next time you can also open it directly with FoxDPI.exe. Close the FoxDPI window before starting a game with anti-cheat.

data.name: TourAccessText
data.value: Tries whether the sites you type open, without touching network settings. Run it with FoxDPI on and off to compare.

data.name: TourDevicesText
data.value: Checks your speakers, microphone and camera step by step: does Windows see them, does the privacy setting allow access, do they work in a test. It changes no setting and records nothing.

data.name: TourReportText
data.value: Every change FoxFix makes stays here and can be undone. The support report you can share when asking for help is also made here.

data.name: TourSettingsText
data.value: Language, updates, theme and accent colour are here. You also find this tour and the uninstall button here.

data.name: TourDoneText
data.value: You can start the tour again from the Settings page at any time. Enjoy FoxFix.

data.name: DpiHintText
data.value: First use "Find the best setting" to find the one that suits your network, then start FoxDPI. It runs in its own window: minimise it and it hides in the notification area, close it and FoxDPI stops. Next time you can start it directly with FoxDPI.exe without opening the main app. Close the FoxDPI window before starting a game with anti-cheat.

data.name: DevIntro
data.value: The steps below only look at the devices Windows sees and at the privacy permission. No setting is changed; the microphone is not listened to and the camera is not turned on. Only the speaker test sound is started by you, and you can stop it at any moment.

data.name: DevPrivacyDeniedUser
data.value: Access is off in the Windows privacy settings.

data.name: DevPrivacyDeniedDesktop
data.value: "Let desktop apps access" is off. FoxFix and most desktop programs cannot use this device.

data.name: DevPrivacyPolicy
data.value: A system policy (group policy) blocks access.

data.name: DevPrivacyUnknown
data.value: The privacy setting could not be read. Check Windows Settings by hand.

data.name: DevVerdictNoDevice

data.name: DevVerdictDisabled

data.name: DevVerdictPrivacy
data.value: {0}: The device exists but the privacy setting blocks access. You can open the Windows setting below.

data.name: DevVerdictUnknown

data.value: Features that are not tested enough yet. Turn one on and it appears in the menu; turn it off and it is hidden.

data.name: ExpDevicesText
data.value: Checks the speaker, microphone and camera devices and the privacy permission. The microphone is not listened to and the camera is not turned on.

data.name: DnsRecommendedWhy
data.value: On many computers FoxDPI does not work without this setting. Do it first, then start FoxDPI. A preview is shown and it can be undone from the Report and history page; if you use a work network or a VPN and can no longer reach internal addresses, undo it.

data.name: SubOverlay
data.value: Shows FPS, frame time and graphics card and processor load in a small strip in the corner of a game.

data.name: OverlayIntro
data.value: Nothing is loaded into games and games are not changed: only the numbers Windows reports are read, and they are not saved or sent anywhere. While the overlay is hidden nothing is measured.

data.name: OverlayEnableText
data.value: While it is on, the shortcut shows and hides the overlay. Turn it off and the shortcut goes back to Windows.

data.name: OverlayHotkeyText
data.value: Click the box and press the keys. At least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win is needed.

data.name: OverlayHotkeyInvalid
data.value: The shortcut is not valid. Example: Ctrl+Shift+F10 (at least one modifier key and one key).

data.name: OverlayHotkeyTaken
data.value: The shortcut {0} is used by another program. Try a different one.

data.name: OverlayFeedFailed
data.value: [{0}] Frames could not be counted, so FPS and frame time show N/A: {1}

data.name: OverlayNothing
data.value: No value is chosen; the overlay will be empty.

data.name: OverlayLimits
data.value: The overlay is not visible in games running in exclusive fullscreen; run the game in windowed or borderless mode. Counting frames needs FoxFix to run as administrator; this feature has to be tested by hand on Windows.

data.name: OverlayFreeHint
data.value: Press "Place it" and the strip appears with sample numbers; drag it where you want it with the mouse, then press "Done placing". The position is saved.
